about: Who the canal wharves' (S2) people and animals are and what they do: every painted figure and animal of S2 (map/text/S2.md, u 20500-29050) at its mapped spot (layout.json, with its recorded moves), and nobody else (map/BUILDING.md). Written by gen/sections/canal/make_people.py (the casting of gen/expand/canal_needs.md, from the 22 existing characters, at real sizes); rerun it after a layout move, a build (its inside.json), the boats agent's boats_people.json or a workshop delivery. figures: character (the character the figure is made for: the catalogue's new characters (boatman, grain_porter, straw_hat, tracker, dark_hat, youth: gen/expand/round2/catalogue.md 1b) are played by their stand_in, the needs list's cast, until each is made; a figure whose painted pose its character can't keep yet is played by the nearest look that can: cast_why), do = [clip, seconds] cycles with clips the playing character has (clips_why, wanted: what is still to make), nudge = [dX, dD] (nudge_why), facing_deg where the map gives none (facing_why), scale for children (scale_why), props = carried prop_<name> parts (props_why), ride (the rider on her donkey). Crew stand on their boats by their layout support (boat deck:/boat roof:) or the boats block's crew, at their layout spots (which carry their boats' moves), never nudged here. boats: the boats agent's (gen/sections/canal/boats_people.json: motion, crew work, haul, tow), copied unchanged except the trackers' haul clips (walk/stand), which are the casting's. walkers: figures painted mid-stride or carrying a load, walking along their painted direction and back (walkers_why). animals: each painted animal at its map position facing hind to fore, model and load from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json (animals_why). Seats the map lacks: gen/sections/canal/seats.json, for the builder. No traffic.

builder_notes.about: What this casting assumes of blender/canal_scene.py and the boats, and what it found. Furniture sizes are the builder's when make_people.py can read them (table/bench/stool/chair/folding_seat("S2.prop.…", …) calls in canal_scene.py, or gen/sections/canal/build/furniture.json {eid: {kind, L, W, yaw, ht}}), else its defaults (furn_default).
builder_notes.seats_json: seats.json X, D is the seat's centre under the hips: build each stool or folding seat there; the grain owner's sack pile needs its level top at seats.json seat_h under his hips (kind "sacks"); "footings" lists the hidden block under the man standing waist-deep in the river
builder_notes.table_tops: people.js stands a figure on the highest colliding surface under rays at X and X +- 0.12 from H + 1.2 m; roots over a table top at these sizes: none
builder_notes.cart: the mule cart as kit_vehicles.open_cart (the builder's call) builds it (bed 2.4 x 1.25 m centred on its painted wheel, its collider the track + 0.12 m to each side); the loader stands on its bed (cart bed H 0.91: the bed's collider top); the lead mule's rump 0.85 m ahead of the bed (between the shafts), both mules moved as recorded (cast.json), so the harness the builder hangs on their hooves follows
builder_notes.stick_bundle: man_with_sticks_bank_24390's bundle of upright sticks stands on the ground beside him: part of the figure's what (needs list), so the builder builds it inside his map ID (no carried prop)
builder_notes.crew_supports: boats.js host() and loyalty_check read only "boat deck: <id>" and "boat roof: <id>": these crew stand on other boat supports and are hosted only when the boats block lists them under its `crew`: boatman_at_windlass_23465 (boat after roof: S2.veh.boat_passenger_22545), boatman_on_ladder_23275 (boat ladder: S2.veh.boat_passenger_22545)

boats_why.boat_towed_mast_23632: 逆水行舟 (pin 15) is towed upstream (west) by the five trackers on the north bank (S2.grp.boat_towed_mast_23632), painted with the tow rope from its mast to the lead tracker's hands: run_m 4.0 (not the page's 8 m default for a towed boat): the page walks each hauler along the boat's heading (174 degrees, nearly due west) with its travel, while their bank runs north-west there, and over 4.2 m all five keep 0.4 m of flat ground south of their feet on the built bank (river_plan.json shifts the trackers' bank -1.1 to -2.9 for it); past that the rear tracker steps onto the slope. speed 0.5 m/s, pauses 8 s at its painted place and 3 s at the far end (the page's defaults). haul: all five trackers (their walk and standing clips are the casting agent's: S3's proposed tow_walk / haul_line takes don't exist yet; {} = the page's walk / idle). tow: the lead tracker S2.fig.tracker_lead_21867 (the rope's far end is painted in his hands). crew: the bowman under the bow hood stands on a `boat bow deck:` support, which host() doesn't read: listed so the page stands him on the moving deck (unlisted, he would stay on the water when the boat moves). Its other ten crew stand on `boat deck:` and `boat roof:` supports and need nothing here.
boats_why.boat_sweep_22000: the boat under way west in midstream worked by its great stern sweep (大橹; pose rowed): run_m 4.0 (not 8): rowed west along its heading it passes 0.24 m from the skiff and 0.2 m from the mat-cargo boat at the end of its run (gen/sections/canal/boats/plan.py, the plan's run check); speed 0.6 m/s (the page's rowed default). crew: four of the six men painted crowding along the loom work the sweep at its crossbar (the page spreads sweep crew 0.6 m either way along the bar: six would stand 0.24 m apart, inside each other; four stand 0.4 m apart, shoulder to shoulder): the four at its inboard end (u 22110-22208). The two painted further aft along the loom (sweepman_capped_22242, sweepman_leaning_on_loom_22285) stand on the after deck at their painted spots (their `boat deck:` support), moving with the boat.

boats_why.boat_mat_cabin_25980: moored; crew lists only the man in the after hood's mouth (`boat stern deck:`), so the page stands him on the stern gallery's deck.
boats_why.boat_grain_27285: moored; crew lists only the steersman reading (`boat stern deck:`), so the page stands him on the stern gallery's deck.
